name: 商量
desc: 商汤日日新大模型对话助手
desc_zh: 商汤日日新大模型对话助手
solves: Writing, translating and reading documents each need their own tool. Shangliang puts them in one conversation, and you can drop a file in and keep asking about it.
solves_zh: 写作、翻译、读文档各要开一个工具。商量把它们放在同一个对话框里，文件丢进去就能接着问。
best_for: You have a piece of text to revise or a long document to actually understand.
best_for_zh: 手头有一段要改的文字，或一份要读懂的长文档。
